test_title: SSC MTS Official Paper (Held On: 19 May, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Select the word from the options which is exactly opposite in meaning to the bracketed word given in the sentence below.**

Having an (active) youngster around the house can be quite wearing.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Abeyant**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The sentence talks about a youngster who is **active**, meaning full of energy and constantly moving around. (सक्रिय)

 
 
• **Example**: *She was active in local politics for many years.*
 
 
 
• The opposite of active is abeyant</stro
